description: Calculates §8 wind on the deck and writes it with the Eurocode Wind Loads plugin's adapter: one EC1W_ load case per global direction, then beam loads (beam deck) or a pressure + fascia nodal loads (plate deck) on the target elements — one element written and read back first, then the rest, with a direction audit. Target: elementIds, a structure group, or (neither) the deck the plugin finds itself. Previews unless apply: true.

acknowledgeOutOfScope.description: Only with the user's agreement: apply §8 to a form it does not cover.

bridge.description: Deck inputs, metres. Omitted geometry is measured from the model (ec_wind_apply) — ec_wind_bridge needs b, d, L and groundToSoffit.

groundToSoffit.description: Height of the soffit above ground (for z_e).

method.description: general (default) or the simplified route the plugin offers.

restraint.description: Table 8.1 parapet/barrier case (plugin values, default none).

sides.description: Parapets on one or both sides (one|both).

structuralForm.description: normal (default), truss, arch, cable-stayed… — forms outside §8 need acknowledgeOutOfScope.

traffic.description: Traffic on the deck for the §8.3.1(5) depth (none, road, rail…).

directions.description: Global load directions to write, e.g. {"Z-": false}. Default: all six (X±, Y±, Z±).

lineOfAction.description: Transverse wind at mid-height of d_tot (aref) or at the section centroids.

vb0.description: Fundamental basic wind velocity v_b,0, m/s (CEN has no map).

zEccentric.description: §8.3.3(5): place the vertical force at e = ±b/4.

name: ec_wind_apply
title: Write bridge wind loads (Eurocode Wind Loads)
